name: Bone Growth, Mineral Density & Skeletal Development

markers.variant_name: Bone genotype does not replace DXA/labs
markers.interpretation: Bone density, fracture risk, growth, and bone healing require phenotype, imaging, nutrient/hormone status, and medical history. DNA is context only.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common DNA markers are context modifiers, not diagnoses. Confirm with phenotype, labs, and clinical context.
